html.zh:
WCA 选择 G5 四触点模式，旨在减少裁判难以肉眼识别的启停违规。文件比较了打印附件、限定魔方位置和加强监督等替代方案，并说明器材供应与选手适应的考虑。

文件记载的计划是从 2027 年规则周期实施，由 WCA 承担所需 G5 更换费用；二阶、魔表、金字塔和斜转排名增加四触点筛选，既有纪录继续保留。
html.en:
The WCA chose G5 four-pad timing to reduce start-and-stop violations that judges cannot reliably detect. The explainer compares attachments, fixed puzzle placement and increased policing, and discusses equipment supply and adaptation.

Its stated plan targets the 2027 regulations cycle, with WCA-funded G5 replacements where needed. It proposes four-pad ranking filters for 2×2×2, Clock, Pyraminx and Skewb while retaining existing records.

html.zh:
同一日历年的锦标赛可以分成主锦标赛、安静锦标赛和最少步锦标赛。主锦标赛可承办所有项目；安静锦标赛仅限三阶、四阶、五阶盲拧、三阶多盲及三阶最少步；最少步锦标赛仅限三阶最少步，也可多地点举办。

项目可以在这些比赛间分配，但同一日历年不得重复举办同一锦标赛项目，也不得超出相应锦标赛类型允许的范围。
html.en:
A year’s championship may be divided into Main, Quiet and Fewest Moves competitions. Main may include any event. Quiet is limited to 3×3×3, 4×4×4 and 5×5×5 Blindfolded, Multi-Blind and Fewest Moves. A Fewest Moves championship may include only that event and can use multiple locations.

Organizers may distribute events between these competitions, but each championship event may occur only once per calendar year and only in an eligible championship type.

title.zh: 廉政委员会调查报告：Pratik Khanna 斜转成绩
title.en: WIC report: Pratik Khanna’s Skewb results

html.zh:
2025-056 号案件审查 Pratik Khanna 的 0.76 秒和 0.86 秒斜转成绩。廉政委员会征询高水平选手意见，并审查其提供的重现视频。

两项成绩均改判 DNF，0.76 秒亚洲纪录随之撤销。委员会无法证明其故意违规，也不能排除计时器故障等非故意原因，因此没有禁赛。
html.en:
Case 2025-056 examined Pratik Khanna’s 0.76- and 0.86-second Skewb results. The WIC consulted experienced solvers and reviewed his replication videos.

Both results became DNF, removing the 0.76-second Asian record. The committee could not establish intentional misconduct or exclude unintentional causes such as timer malfunction, so it imposed no ban.

title.zh: 廉政委员会调查报告：Jaehyun Jeong 三阶最少步成绩
title.en: WIC report: Jaehyun Jeong’s FMC results

html.zh:
2026-030 号案件涉及 Silent Korea Spring 2026 的三阶最少步（FMC）亚洲纪录。报告记载，Jaehyun Jeong 承认在第一轮第二、三次尝试中用手机查询解法。

廉政委员会决定取消相关亚洲纪录成绩，并禁止其参赛一年。委员会也审查了部分早期成绩，但认为证据不足，未进一步取消成绩。
html.en:
Case 2026-030 concerns FMC Asian records at Silent Korea Spring 2026. The report records Jaehyun Jeong’s admission that he consulted a phone during the second and third attempts of the first round.

The WIC imposed a one-year competition ban and disqualified the affected Asian-record results. It also examined selected earlier results, but found insufficient evidence for additional disqualifications.
